concept: Interaction-picture and hybrid simulation methods can outperform direct Trotterization for some Hamiltonians
summary: When a Hamiltonian has a natural dominant component, time dependence, or unfavorable direct product-formula scaling, interaction-picture and hybrid approaches can reduce resource requirements compared with direct Trotterization.
applies_to: Hamiltonians with dominant exactly simulable terms
applications where direct Trotter depth is too high
limitations: These alternatives may require additional implementation support beyond the current OpenQEvo native methods.
Some alternatives trade circuit depth for oracle, ancilla, or decomposition complexity.
implications: If direct Trotterization is impractical, mark the recommendation as conditional and identify missing method support.
Use the method-selection layer to distinguish current implementation availability from literature-supported suitability.

evidence.note: Compares hybrid interaction-picture simulation strategies against standard Trotterization.
Discusses resource efficiency and comparison points for Hamiltonian simulation methods.
